mapper.select: WITH expanded_problem_tags AS ( SELECT p.slug, pt.value AS tag, CASE WHEN #{locale} = 'en-US' THEN pt.label_en ELSE pt.label_zh END AS label FROM problem p JOIN problem_tag_assignment assignment ON assignment.problem_id = p.id JOIN problem_tag pt ON pt.id = assignment.tag_id WHERE pt.active = TRUE ), tag_catalog AS ( SELECT tag, label, COUNT(*) AS problem_count FROM expanded_problem_tags GROUP BY tag, label HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minProblemCount} ), latest_reviews AS ( SELECT problem_slug, total_score FROM ( SELECT problem_slug, total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY problem_slug ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC) AS row_number FROM practice_code_review WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) ranked_reviews WHERE row_number = 1 ), tag_review_scores AS ( SELECT ept.tag, COUNT(*) AS reviewed_problem_count, AVG(lr.total_score) AS raw_average_score FROM latest_reviews lr JOIN expanded_problem_tags ept ON ept.slug = lr.problem_slug GROUP BY ept.tag ) SELECT tc.tag, tc.label, tc.problem_count, COALESCE(trs.reviewed_problem_count, 0) AS reviewed_problem_count, trs.raw_average_score FROM tag_catalog tc LEFT JOIN tag_review_scores trs ON trs.tag = tc.tag ORDER BY tc.problem_count DESC, tc.tag ASC
